description: This file defines the ViewOrganizationGeneralInformationController class, which manages the preparation of data and components for rendering an organization’s general information view in an HRM system. It extends an abstract controller, uses traits for dependency injection, and sets up a Vue.js component with properties for number of employees and country list.

classes.name: ViewOrganizationGeneralInformationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing data and setting up the Vue component for the organization general information view. It fetches employee count and country list, then configures the component before rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering by retrieving employee count and country list, then configures and sets the Vue component for the view.
